_comment: Lazarus7 (c) 2026 lance6x5, MIT. Button combos for Android HP Slate 7 tablets. Read by src/Lazarus7.Android.psm1 and docs/index.html. confidence: hp = HP Support Community / HP docs; reported = third-party guides or forum reports; generic = standard Android or chip-family behaviour, not confirmed on this model. Keep ASCII.

combos.keys: Tablet off: hold Vol- + Vol+ + Power together; release when the HP logo appears.
combos.notes: If that boots normally, try Power + Vol+ only.

combos.keys: Tablet off: hold Vol+ and plug the USB cable into the PC; keep holding about 5 s.
combos.notes: PC should show a Rockchip device (USB VID 2207). Needs Rockchip DriverAssistant.

combos.keys: Recovery mode -> wipe data/factory reset -> Yes.
combos.notes: Erases everything. A Google account lock (FRP) may apply afterwards.

combos.keys: Tablet off: hold Vol+ + Power; release when the HP logo appears.
combos.notes: Opens the bootloader menu; choose recovery from it.

combos.keys: Boot menu (above) -> Vol- once -> Power to pick "Fastboot protocol".
combos.notes: If fastboot finds nothing, use the HP vendor ID: fastboot -i 0x03F0 devices

combos.keys: Tablet off: hold Vol+, press Power, then release Vol+ right away.
combos.notes: Owners report landing in APX by also pressing Vol- during the recovery combo. Restoring from APX needs HP-signed images. To leave APX: hold Power 10+ s.

combos.keys: Tablet off: hold Vol+ + Power; release as soon as the HP logo appears.
Boot menu -> Vol- to "Fastboot protocol" -> Power.
combos.notes: Same Tegra 4 bootloader as the Extreme. Try fastboot -i 0x03F0 devices.

combos.keys: Tablet off: hold Vol+, press Power, then release Vol+ right away.
combos.notes: Restoring from APX needs HP-signed images. To leave APX: hold Power 10+ s.

combos.keys: Tablet off: hold Vol+ + Vol- + Power together; release at the HP logo.
Tablet off: hold Power + Vol+ until the HP logo appears and the tablet vibrates.
combos.notes: The recovery menu shows a few seconds after the logo.

combos.keys: Recovery mode -> Vol- to "Wipe data/factory reset" -> Power -> "Yes -- delete all user data" -> Power.
combos.notes: Then "reboot system now". A Google account lock (FRP) may apply afterwards.

combos.keys: Tablet off: try Power + Vol+ first; if it boots normally, try Vol+ + Vol- + Power.
combos.notes: No model-specific report found - these are the two combos the other Slate 7s use.

common.keys: Vol+ / Vol- to move, Power to select. Touch does not work in recovery.
Hold Power, tap Vol+ once, release both - the recovery menu appears.

common.action: Force restart / power off when frozen

common.keys: Hold Power -> long-press "Power off" -> OK. Restart normally to leave.

common.action: Reboot from a PC (USB debugging on)
common.keys: adb reboot recovery   |   adb reboot bootloader   |   adb reboot
common.notes: Lazarus7 > Other HP tablets has these as menu items.
